trouper|UW T ER.why: It is a word, but P replaces the T before the final ER, so the rime is UW-P-ER, not UW-T-ER.

wooer|UW T ER.why: It is a word, but it has no T between the vowel and ER (UW1 ER0), so the key differs from UW-T-ER.

beauts|UW T S.why: 'Beaut' is an informal word, and its plural ends in UW1 T S, the same key as 'roots'.

brutes|UW T S.why: It ends in UW1 T S, the same key as 'roots'.

foots|UW T S.why: 'Foots' has the vowel UH1 (F UH1 T S), not UW, so the vowel differs from 'roots'.

soups|UW T S.why: It ends in UW1 P S, so the P differs from the T in 'roots'.
